Operating-system redistributables copied out of C:/Windows/System32 are covered by their own redistribution terms and are not listed.

FFmpeg (OpenCV's prebuilt videoio plugin, built without GPL components) -- shipped as opencv_videoio_ffmpeg4130_64.dll next to umacapture.exe and loaded at run time by opencv_world4130.dll

This component is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later. It is shipped unmodified, as a separate dynamically loaded library that umacapture does not link against, so it can be replaced with a modified version by substituting the file. It is FFmpeg 4.4.6, prebuilt by the OpenCV project and taken unchanged from the OpenCV 4.13.0 Windows distribution (https://github.com/opencv/opencv/releases/tag/4.13.0). The FFmpeg 4.4.6 sources are published at https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/releases/tag/n4.4.6, and this exact binary together with the scripts that produced it at https://github.com/opencv/opencv_3rdparty/tree/d82ad9a54a7b42a1648a9cae8fed5c2f20ea396c/ffmpeg -- the commit that OpenCV 4.13.0's own 3rdparty/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.cmake pins (branch ffmpeg/4.x_20251226).

Included in the umacapture Windows build.
